about: Sandbox SB0, the Site Bench: the words of the page's explain layer. The engine's data and every number are in e0.json, with the check of the run in 52 weeks and 31 December against one LP over the whole year (its `reference` block).

rules.title: Decisions, goal and rules, in words

items.v: Every hour: how much to buy and send back (home) or sell and spill, leaving wind unused (farm), what goes into and out of the battery, and what the electrolyzer and tank do.
The lowest yearly cost for the home, or the highest yearly revenue for the farm, with the sizes you set.
Each hour balances; nothing runs above its size; for every 100 units charged, the battery gives back 85, and waiting loses nothing; the line and the buyer's take are limits.
All 8,760 hours of 2025, as 52 weeks and 31 December, one small [[linear-program|linear program]] each. Storage is half full where they meet, so they join into one year.
A tiny wear charge on battery use and, on the farm, a hair's preference for selling earlier in the week. Both are left out of every number shown.
Every total shown is the same on every least-cost schedule. With storage, the hour-by-hour schedule, and the hour counts read from it, can differ.

bound.title: Where the bench's answers hold
holds: the weather and prices of 2025 are a fair guide to the next 25 or 30 years;
the sourced costs, converted to 2025 dollars, hold for the whole horizon;
the grid is always there to buy from (home) or to sell to, up to the line (farm).
leaves: storage carried from one week to the next (the check below measures what that changes);
outages, taxes, tax credits, incentives and financing;
how other plants respond to the site: the CO₂ uses one average factor (CF6 explains the difference).
bound.source: Hourly patterns: EIA-930 for SPP, 2025, reshaped to EIA's capacity factors. Costs and factors: EIA, DOE and NLR, with dates, in the sources below.

check.title: Checked on one full-year LP
check.lede: The test runs each preset again as one LP over all 8,760 hours, with storage free to carry across weeks: it can only do as well or better.

sizing.title: Size it for me, run on the year
sizing.lede: Sizes chosen on representative weeks, then rounded, need not be the best on the year. The test runs three cases and one control step either side of each suggestion.
